import pandas as pd

items = pd.read_csv("order_items.csv")
orders = pd.read_csv("orders.csv", parse_dates=["order_date"])
items["revenue"] = items["quantity"] * items["unit_price"] * (1 - items["discount"])
df = orders.merge(items.groupby("order_id", as_index=False)["revenue"].sum(), on="order_id", validate="one_to_one")
df = df[df["status"] != "cancelled"].copy()
df["quarter"] = df["order_date"].dt.to_period("Q")

q = df.groupby("quarter").agg(
    revenue=("revenue", "sum"),
    orders=("order_id", "count"),
    customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
)
q["aov"] = q["revenue"] / q["orders"]

change = q.loc["2025Q4"] / q.loc["2025Q3"] - 1
revenue_growth = round(change["revenue"], 3)
orders_growth = round(change["orders"], 3)
aov_growth = round(change["aov"], 3)

q4 = df[df["quarter"] == "2025Q4"]
bf_share = round(q4.loc[q4["coupon_code"] == "BLACKFRIDAY25", "revenue"].sum() / q4["revenue"].sum(), 3)

growth_2024 = round(q.loc["2024Q4", "revenue"] / q.loc["2024Q3", "revenue"] - 1, 3)
print(change.round(3), bf_share, growth_2024)

checks.test: isinstance(q, pd.DataFrame) and len(q) == 8 and {'revenue', 'orders', 'customers', 'aov'} <= set(q.columns)
